style: One shared gold numeral-and-laurel design for 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300 TR; all use the standard gold frame.

jobs.name: Century Club
jobs.symbol: Gold 100 with the shared simple laurel.
jobs.description: Recorded a game with 100 or more TR.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied gold "300" numeral-and-laurel achievement emblem.
Make the matching "100" variant of this EXACT design. Change only the numeral from "300" to "100". Keep the polished warm yellow-gold finish identical to the reference, with pale champagne-gold front faces, deeper golden bevels and upper-left highlights. All metal surfaces must stay GOLD, without bronze, copper or silver.
Preserve the exact two separate laurel sprigs, each with three broad plain leaves: same shapes, positions, size and open gap at the bottom. Preserve the bold rounded sans-serif type style, digit height, baseline, stroke weights, spacing, bevel depth, overall composition and square canvas. The numeral is the largest element. All three digits distinct and fully readable with clear counters. Keep the group centered at the same size as the reference.
Text (verbatim): "100". No other text.
Preserve genuinely transparent alpha outside the objects, inside the zero counter(s) and between all shapes. No background, black fill, checkerboard, halo, glow, floor, cast shadow, badge frame or added decoration.
Return ONE transparent PNG emblem, not a grid or presentation sheet.

jobs.name: Triple Century
jobs.symbol: Gold 300 with the shared simple laurel.
jobs.description: Recorded a game with 300 or more TR.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached bronze "100" achievement emblem on a transparent background.
Make the matching GOLD tier of this EXACT emblem. Change the numeral to "300" and recolor all metal surfaces to warm polished yellow gold, with pale champagne-gold front faces and deeper golden bevels. Use only warm yellow-gold tones, with no copper or silver.
Preserve the exact laurel shape: same two separate curved sprigs with three broad leaves on each side, same leaf sizes, same positions. Preserve the two zero shapes, stroke weights, numeral height, baseline, overall layout, spacing, lighting direction, restrained bevel depth, silhouette and square canvas. Replace only the first digit with a matching bold sans-serif "3".
Keep the group the same overall size and centered at the same position. All three digits must be distinct and fully readable.
Preserve actual transparent alpha outside the objects, inside both zero holes and all gaps. No background, no black fill, no halo, no glow, no floor or cast shadow, no frame, no new ornament, no other text. Return a single transparent PNG emblem.
jobs.status: Existing gold artwork retained; placement matched to the five-milestone family.

notes.finish: All five milestones share gold artwork and the same default gold frame. The displayed number identifies the threshold; there is no bronze/silver tier progression.
notes.names: 150 TR is Century and a Half; 250 TR is Two and a Half Centuries.
notes.rules: Recorded terraform_rating >= the named threshold in any match; the five thresholds are cumulative, not exclusive ranges.
notes.source: Gold 300 is the existing reference for the four matching variants. Its original bronze source is retained under references for provenance.
